competences.description: Attacks the enemy, dealing damage and transferring 2 harmful effects on you to the enemy. Increases the damage by 15% if there are no harmful effects to transfer.

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times, removing 1 beneficial effect and setting back the target's skills to MAX cooldown with each hit.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
Puts the target's skill on cool down.

competences.description: Increases the damage dealt to enemies with harmful effects by 100% and decreases the damage taken from enemies with no beneficial effects by 25%. Additionally, decreases the HP of all enemies except the target by 40% of the damage dealt and inflicts Continuous Damage for 1 turn after each hit. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Increases damage per debuff on the target
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
Decreases damage received by a certain amount
